description:
How many distinct business addresses and phones this carrier
reports across FMCSA's independent records of it (census
registration, licensing and insurance filings, and its own
self-reported crash records). Mailing addresses are excluded —
differing from the physical address there is normal.

Paid. Cheaper than either identity tool; one row, no graph.

usdot_number.description: Carrier USDOT number (digits only), the canonical FMCSA carrier identifier.
